tool.name: Qwen 2.5 (72B)
tool.summary: Alibaba Cloud's flagship open LLM featuring world-class multilingual capabilities across 29+ languages, 128k context support, and leading coding benchmarks.
tool.architecture: Dense Transformer with RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, and GQA.
tool.usage:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct", device_map="auto")
tool.limitations: Full precision requires ~145GB VRAM; requires 4-bit quant to run on single 24GB/48GB GPU.
